All six capacity slots fit two cards; active profile is read-only and never switched. Source options, capacity/cell limits and capacity scaling are extracted from existing Power pages into power_fields, which both pages and wizard consume. Analog replaces the servo live poll only on Power cards; ESC readings reuse motor_telemetry. Complete received battery and SmartFuel records round-trip through the existing wizard save/discard/EEPROM boundary; the battery codec also accepts its flat parse result.
